about: Boundary rules each gate enforces. Quoted from CLAUDE.md (section named in `ref`), the ADR or the doc the gate's own header cites. A gate without an entry here falls back to the header comment of its script (oracle source = that script, ref = 'header').

rules.invariant: Only two ways out of the tree: NPMJS or WORKSPACE. No link: / file: / portal: / absolute paths in package.json, cordis*.yml, .npmrc, pnpm-workspace.yaml.
Plugin identity declared in three places must match: package.json name, cordis row, bundle id.
lib/client.js is committed and equals a clean rebuild of its source; a stale bundle ships stale code to customers.
vendor/ is others' code changed only through its own -tracy.N path; dsh-passwords guards the sign-in gate of every surface.
Code files and anything outsiders can read are in English; Vietnamese belongs to doc files and conversation.
On-screen and public text uses the canonical vocabulary and none of the four banned words.
Every language in Settings > Language is complete on Tracy's and dsh's screens; an English string added or reworded is translated in every language in the same change.
.claude/skills/ is a symlink mirror of .agents/skills/; a real copy is a second truth that drifts.
Every test file belongs to exactly one run group and every group is green.
oxlint, typecheck and format check are clean (non-mutating, exactly what pnpm test:lint runs).
